en.headline: Observatory expects higher coastal water levels tonight
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said the combined effect of a spring tide and the northeast monsoon may bring slightly higher water levels, with minor flooding possible in some low-lying areas.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a special weather tip early on Wednesday warning that water levels along local coastal areas are expected to be slightly higher than normal tonight.

The Observatory said the higher levels result from the combined effect of a spring tide and the northeast monsoon currently affecting the Guangdong coast. Minor flooding may occur over some low-lying areas.
No rainstorm or other warning signals are in force. Residents in low-lying coastal districts were advised to take note of the conditions.

zh.headline: 天文台料今晚沿岸水位較高 低窪地區或現輕微水浸
zh.dek: 天文台表示受天文大潮及東北季候風共同影響，預料今晚沿岸水位較正常稍高，部分低窪地區可能出現輕微水浸。
body: 天文台今日凌晨發出特別天氣提示，預料本港今晚沿岸地區水位較正常稍高。
天文台指，水位較高是受天文大潮及正影響廣東沿岸的東北季候風共同影響。部分低窪地區可能出現輕微水浸。
目前無暴雨或其他警告信號生效。天文台建議低窪沿岸地區居民留意最新情況。
